title: Measure the distance between every pair of tracks
summary: Collects the board's tracks with a board iterator and measures every pair with PrimPrimDistance, reporting the closest touching and non-touching pairs; covers the MaxCoord result and the quadratic cost on AD's main thread.
phrasings: find the closest two tracks on a board
measure distance between two objects on a PCB

commands.name: ClearanceCheck
commands.description: Measure the distance between every pair of tracks
commands.params: Tracks=<n> (how many of the board's tracks to measure, default 0 = all)|MaxTracks=<n> (refuse to measure more tracks than this, default 500, 0 = no limit)|SameLayerOnly=true (optional)
